newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai exchange turnover soars in Jan-Aug.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai exchange turnover soars in Jan-Aug.

text.p: Turnover of stocks, bonds and funds on the Shanghai stock exchange in the first eight months of 1996 soared compared with the same 1995 period, the Shanghai Securities News reported on Saturday.

Trading of stocks was worth 382.525 billion yuan, an increase of 83.19 percent over the same 1995 period, with trading in July and August alone equivalent to 83.65 percent of the turnover in the first six months of 1996, it said.
Trading of treasury bills in the eight-month period was 845.686 billion yuan, a 6.25-fold increase over the same 1995 period, it said.
Trading of funds was 27.7 billion yuan, a 4.32-fold increase over the same 1995 period, it said.
The rise in stock trading was due in part to the introduction of a 30-share index and to the stimulus provided by the publication of interim results in July and August, it said.
